title: A Server Action without its own auth check can be called by anyone, even from a page that redirects strangers
symptoms: An admin page redirects signed-out visitors, but its form action still runs when posted to directly
A 'use server' function changes or deletes data without calling your auth helper
A signed-in user can change another user's records by passing a different id
cause: An exported Server Action is reachable by a direct POST request, not only through your UI. A page-level authentication check does not extend to the Server Actions defined in it, because each action is a separate entry point. Checking that a user is logged in is also not enough when the action acts on a record they do not own.
fix: Verify authentication and authorization inside every Server Action, or in a server-only data access layer each action calls: get the session, throw if there is none, then check that the user owns or may act on the specific record before changing it.
affected: Next.js App Router apps with Server Actions that change data
